why: Both land on bank automation with profit per financial-institution customer and both drop the broad fight with Rival I, but Analysis 1 keeps accounting and bookkeeping users inside the hedgehog and explicitly lists the narrow, accounting-machine-dependent product line as a brutal fact. Analysis 2 is slightly sharper on the one-leader dependence risk ("genius with helpers", named successors), yet neither warns against cost cuts starving engineering, so Analysis 1 edges it overall.
